jobOpening.jobOpeningName: Security Engineer 資訊安全工程師
jobOpening.description:
We are currently hiring for Security Engineer professional to join us: 


We are looking for Security Engineer who will be responsible for managing worldwide Information Technology. We are SecOps, whose mission is: “To make everyone more productive and efficient.” We hope this Security Engineer can agree with our philosophy and achieve it with us together. So far, 17LIVE keeps growing fast. We have offices in Taiwan, Japan, Hong Kong and America. We also have colleagues work remotely in other countries. You can have the opportunity to work with worldwide colleagues. In order to let each department grow together, the Technology Service department plays a very important role.


Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for global information systems implementation, integration, and maintenance.
  • Company security and personnel security policy development and implementation
  • Information security education and training
  • Implementation, maintenance, and management of ISO27001 (ISMS) system
  • Assist in handling information security incidents and tracking system vulnerabilities to improve operations efficiency


The following experiences are favored for this position:

Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of work experience
  • Experience in managing firewall or related network device
  • Experience in managing google workspace, Slack
  • Experience in JAMF, or Azure Active Directory
  • Experience in ISMS/ISO 27001 
  • Experience in Mac management experience
  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in coding, as it is crucial for understanding technical concepts and troubleshooting issues
  • Expertise in cloud firewall technologies and cloud vulnerability management
